name: Customizable Card Box with More Cutouts

captions.detailed: This 3D model features a two-part parametric card box consisting of a main bottom container and a matching top lid, positioned side-by-side. Both parts are rectangular with hollowed-out interiors, thin walls, and large triangular cutouts in their bottom faces to facilitate card removal. The bottom container includes side tab slots, small locking wedges, and a large curved finger notch on one of its shorter ends, while the lid includes matching slot cutouts on its side walls to receive the locking tabs.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, two-part card box in OpenSCAD consisting of a bottom container and a sliding/locking lid. The design must include adjustable parameters for the card dimensions, wall thickness, stack height, tab dimensions, and cutout percentages, featuring a curved finger notch on the side of the bottom container and triangular-scaled cylinder cutouts through the bottom faces of both pieces.
captions.factory: The script constructs the bottom container and the lid using boolean difference operations on basic cube primitives. The bottom container's base is formed by subtracting a scaled cylinder from a flat bottom plate, while its main body is hollowed out with a cube and modified with two vertical tab slots, a rotated cylinder for the end finger cutout, and another scaled cylinder for the bottom cutout. Small locking wedges are created by subtracting rotated cubes from rectangular blocks and translating them into place, while the lid is formed by subtracting a hollow inner cube, side tab slots, and a scaled bottom cutout cylinder from a larger main cube.
